title: Feedback on someone who's just started dipping toes into game dev
author: deebonz
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I'm a fresh and new into game development and just starting to enjoy what we can do around making games with AI. I personally think AI is an amazing tool that further broadens our current capabilities to make games a lot more capable and exciting if used the right way.

I was hoping I could get some feedback and traction on my three games and have expert feedback which is all of you : )

Thank you!

Deep Dive:  
A game where you dive underwater and search for treasure, hunt for fish and win boss fights  
[https://run.world/cocopops/deep-dive-the-unknown-depths](https://run.world/cocopops/deep-dive-the-unknown-depths)

Firefly:  
Aim and reaction and co-ordination trainer  
[https://run.world/cocopops/firefly](https://run.world/cocopops/firefly)

Tap Tap Umbrella:   
A simple game to float though a maze and unlock new players   
[https://run.world/cocopops/tap-tap-umbrella](https://run.world/cocopops/tap-tap-umbrella)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Hey u/deebonz, this falls under Rule 4. Sharing your game is okay here, free or paid, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).

replies.author: deebonz
replies.body: Will do and just edited - hope this is enough! thank u!
